purpose: Prevent semantic duplication across published paid notes, free notes, queued notes and research opportunities.

publishedFreeReceipts.note: Scan when present; Aug 24 public free URLs are also stored in strategy/current.json.

normalization: Convert full-width and half-width forms consistently.
Remove decorative brackets, counts, dates and platform suffixes before title comparison.
Normalize close operational synonyms such as 引継ぎ/引き継ぎ, 証拠/根拠/証憑, 検品/確認/受入, 差戻し/手戻り, 版/バージョン.
Compare semantic axes, not only token overlap.
fingerprint.hardDuplicate: Same cluster + reader + moment + failure + artifact, even when title wording or number of steps differs.
fingerprint.adjacentAllowed: At least one material axis differs and the reader completes a different artifact or decision.
fingerprint.manualReview: Same failure and artifact with a broader or narrower reader; keep only if the workflow, evidence and exclusions materially differ.

preDraftCommandLogic: Load every title from publication receipts and both queue indexes.
Load freeTitle, paidTitle and boothTitle from opportunity_map.json.
Build the five-axis fingerprint for the candidate.
Reject hard duplicates; send adjacent matches to manual semantic review.
Store the accepted fingerprint and duplicateNote before drafting.
rule: Changing a count, adjective, target platform or article archetype does not create a new intent.
